reason: I already have a freelancer I trust for copy, and for quick stuff I use ChatGPT. I'm not going to move budget I have to account for onto an unaudited new platform where I pay in USDC.
objection: Winner-takes-all means most entries are throwaway and I'm judged by an AI I don't know. If something goes wrong I have to explain to my boss why I sent crypto to an unaudited startup instead of just paying my freelancer.
would_change_my_mind: A free first task that shows a result clearly better than my freelancer or ChatGPT, plus a way to pay by card and an invoice I can expense.
